title.zh: BOSS直聘开源33B Agent模型：20项自评领先17项，最终目标却是3B
title.en: BOSS直聘开源33B Agent模型：20项自评领先17项，最终目标却是3B

current_state.zh: BOSS直聘's Nanbeige Lab open-sourced Nanbeige4.3-33B, an Apache-2.0 coding and office-agent model with 512K context that it says tops 17 of 20 published benchmarks against Qwen, Meta and Gemma comparators, and which will serve as the teacher for a forthcoming distilled Nanbeige4.3-3B.
